subject: Request: Third-party ecosystem inventory, retention & KMS details for BlueArc Health
messages:
From: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@bluearchealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Third-party inventory + subprocessor evidence for BlueArc procurement

Hi Sean / Marissa,

As part of our procurement security review for BlueArc Health we need a consolidated view of Redwood's third-party ecosystem and evidence for a handful of items in our SIG-lite. Specifically: 

- A machine-readable list (CSV) of active subprocessors with purpose, host region, and whether they have access to PHI.
- Your current SOC 2 Type II summary (not the full report) and date of most recent audit.
- Data retention matrix describing retention by data class (logs, user content, metadata).
- KMS/Key management posture: do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK/CMEK), HSM integration, and how audit logs are exposed?
- Any known subprocessors that perform cross-border support or have persistent access to production data stores.

Attached is our SIG-lite questionnaire (BlueArc_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx) with sections we will prioritize — if you can populate the subprocessor and retention sections that would be most helpful.

We are aiming to finalize security review notes by May 12 to keep procurement on track. Could you confirm ETA and the best point of contact for technical follow-ups?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dubois
Senior Security Manager, BlueArc Health
procurement@bluearchealth.com

--- Attachment: BlueArc_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (xlsx) ---

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@bluearchealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Third-party inventory + subprocessor evidence for BlueArc procurement

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We'll take this on.

Plan: 
- Marissa will produce the subprocessor CSV and flag any subprocessors with PHI access.
- Priyom will pull the data retention matrix and highlight per-region retention controls.
- I'll confirm the KMS posture and provide the SOC2 summary.

ETA: We should be able to deliver the first-pass artifacts (CSV + retention matrix + SOC2 summary) by EOD Thu 7-May. If BlueArc needs a technical call, please propose times and we can schedule.

Are there any specific fields you require in the CSV beyond: name, purpose, region, PHI_access (yes/no), contract_modality (subprocessor/vendor), and last_contract_review_date?

I'll also loop in Neha to vet any subprocessors that might have higher compliance needs (PHI / EU residency).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. One quick clarification on KMS: we need to know whether Redwood supports customer-generated keys (BYOK/CMEK) for hosted deployments, and if you offer an HSM-backed option (partner HSM or customer-hosted HSM). Also, how are key rotation events and KMS access logged and made available for customer audits?

Also, can you confirm whether the three PHI-access vendors have signed business associate agreements (BAAs) or similar controls? That will be a gating factor for the procurement team.

We can do a 30-minute technical call; earliest availability Thu 7-May 14:00–16:00 EDT.

Procurement deadline for the packet is May 12 — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Claire

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2026 17:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Third-party inventory + subprocessor evidence for BlueArc procurement

Claire — attaching the requested artifacts and answering your KMS/BAA questions below.

Attachments (packaged):
- redwood_subprocessors_2026-05.csv (full inventory)
- data_retention_matrix_2026.xlsx (retention by class + TTLs)
- SOC2_Type2_summary_2025.pdf (summary of scope and date)
- kms_integration_summary.pdf (how we support BYOK/CMEK + HSM notes)

KMS / HSM / Audit logs (short answers):
- Hosted API: default is Redwood-managed keys for convenience. We offer CMEK (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments — customers can import keys via supported KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).
- HSM: We support HSM-backed keys via partner integrations (Yubico/Thales partners) for Dedicated and Private. For fully on-prem customers we provide guidance for customer HSM integration; for VPC-hosted setups we can enable partner HSM-backed keys on request.
- Audit logs & key rotation: Key usage and management events are surfaced in the customer audit logs (exportable to S3/Cloud Storage or pushed to SIEM via webhook). Rotation events are recorded with timestamps and principal identity; we can provide a time-bounded extract for audit review.

BAAs & PHI vendors: All three vendors marked PHI_access = Y are covered under vendor-level contractual addenda; two have BAAs in place and one is in the late stage of signing (we can share the redacted agreement).

If you'd like to run a short call, Thu 7-May 15:00 EDT works for our security lead (Neha) and Priyom. Please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best regards,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199
